# Copilot Instructions

## Project context

This repository is the Clickatell technical assessment workspace for a document Q&A service.

- Backend: FastAPI with a small service-oriented structure.
- Frontend: Vite + React + TypeScript.
- Local secrets stay in .env and are never committed.
- Keep the implementation explainable, tested, and incrementally committed.

## Working expectations

- Prefer small, atomic commits with conventional commit messages.
- Keep changes focused and easy to explain in a walkthrough.
- Maintain the existing architecture and documentation files: CLAUDE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, DECISIONS.md, CODE_REVIEW.md, and README.md.
- When introducing a new module or architectural choice, explain the trade-off clearly.
- If one instruction or workflow file changes, update the relevant partner file so the guidance stays consistent across CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md.
